subject: Aligning renewal cadence, governance items, and QBR date options
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Shaw <olivia.shaw@heliosai.com>, Procurement <procurement@heliosai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-08T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Aligning renewal cadence, governance items, and QBR date options

Hi Olivia / Helios team,

Thanks for the productive run of demos last month — excited about the traction HeliosAI is getting with the new embeddings pipeline. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off the formal renewal/orchestration thread so we have a clear timeline, owners, and a QBR window locked in. High level: HeliosAI's current term ends 2028-01-31; this thread covers term options, proposed retainer, headroom for a stepped burst during Q1, and a QBR to align execs and SRE.

Quick proposal and asks: 
- Timeline: target signature by 2027-12-28 to allow legal/procurement cycles (we can compress if needed).
- Term options: 12mo standard vs 24mo discounted retainer (attached draft redlines for the 24mo path).
- Capacity: propose a 25% headroom buffer for seasonal Q1 burst with optional staircase uplift in month 6.
- Governance & evidence: procurement/infosec asked for audit log retention and SOC-2 evidence — attaching a short package for review.
- QBR: please pick 2 windows below (all times PT):
  * Wed 2027-12-15, 10:00-11:30 PT
  * Thu 2027-12-16, 08:30-10:00 PT
  * Tue 2027-12-21, 09:00-10:30 PT

Next steps I propose internally: Marissa will run the mutual action plan and stakeholder invites; Kimberly will confirm SRE staffing and SLA notes; Connor will serve as technical lead during the QBR. Olivia, can your procurement contact confirm preferred contract routing (DocuSign vs internal PO + net terms)? Also tagging Daniel from legal if Helios wants to flag redline items early.

Attachments: HeliosAI-MA-Redlines-v1.pdf; QBR-Agenda-draft.docx

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you prefer to triage dates.

Best,

Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0139

From: Olivia Shaw <olivia.shaw@heliosai.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@heliosai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-08T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aligning renewal cadence, governance items, and QBR date options

Sergio — thanks for the clear outline. We're aligned on moving quickly. A few notes from our side: 

- Procurement prefers DocuSign but will need a short PO for internal tracking; procurement@heliosai.com is on this thread.
- Legal (Daniel) will review the redlines; he asked for a short summary of material changes — could you flag the top 3 redline items in one bullet?
- QBR availability: we can do Thu 2027-12-16 08:30 PT or Tue 2027-12-21 09:00 PT; Thu is slightly better for exec availability.

I'll loop Daniel in separately but tagging here so it's visible. Marissa / Kimberly — from your side, please confirm who should prepare the runbook and whether SRE can share a short operations playbook (1 pager) for the QBR.

Thanks,
Olivia
VP, Platform Operations | HeliosAI
olivia.shaw@heliosai.com

Thanks — I'll take the MAP and invite owners. Internal action items from me: 
- I'll draft the mutual action plan and share by EOD 2027-12-09 (includes milestones: legal review, PO/DocuSign, engineering runbook delivery).
- Sergio: can you bullet the top 3 redline asks for Daniel (concise one-liner each)? That will speed legal review.
- Kimberly: please confirm SRE rep for the QBR and whether we can produce the 1-page ops playbook by 2027-12-14.
- Connor: can you prepare a short demo of the burst-handling changes and expected latency at 25% uplift? 10 minutes max.

I'll set a tentative QBR invite for Thu 2027-12-16 08:30 PT and mark as tentative until Olivia/Procurement confirm. If Thu is blocked, we'll flip to Tue 2027-12-21 09:00 PT.

Internal note: Legal will need the attachment named "HeliosAI-MA-Redlines-v1.pdf" and a short redline summary inserted into the MAP doc.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Shaw <olivia.shaw@heliosai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@heliosai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Daniel Lee - HeliosAI Legal <dan.lee@heliosai.com>
Date: 2027-12-09T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aligning renewal cadence, governance items, and QBR date options

Olivia — perfect, thanks for the quick reply. Quick redline summary for Daniel (top 3):
1) Data residency & audit logs: we propose 365-day audit log retention in scope; customer can request extension via addendum.
2) Incident SLA credits: preserve current SLA structure but limit credits for third-party outages; propose cap at 20% of monthly fee.
3) Term & early termination: 24mo retainer path includes a stepped discount and pro-rated early termination with 90-day notice.

Confirming: we'll tentatively hold Thu 2027-12-16 08:30-10:00 PT for the QBR (invites going shortly). Marissa will circulate the MAP tomorrow with milestones. Kimberly — flag me if SRE can't commit to the ops playbook timeline.

If procurement needs a compressed signature path, we can fast-track DocuSign and prioritize final redline items.

Thank you all — looking forward to the QBR.

Best,
Sergio
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
